mathematical_observations: The observed mean spacing is significantly larger than the predicted mean spacing based on the Riemann-von Mangoldt formula.
The standard deviation of the observed spacings is larger than the predicted standard deviation for the Gaussian Unitary Ensemble (GUE).

rh_status.reasoning: The Riemann Hypothesis (RH) is a conjecture about the distribution of the zeros of the Riemann zeta function. Finite data, such as the spacing between zeros, cannot definitively prove or disprove RH. The data provided does not provide enough information to make a conclusive statement about the RH.

what_would_be_needed: A much larger dataset of zeros of the Riemann zeta function.
A more detailed analysis of the spacing distribution, including higher-order statistics.
A comparison with other theoretical predictions and models.
honest_limits: The finite nature of the data limits its ability to make definitive statements about the Riemann Hypothesis.
The observed data does not align with the predictions from the Riemann-von Mangoldt formula or the Gaussian Unitary Ensemble.
Further research and analysis are needed to understand the implications of the observed data.
